notes: Curated OTP and concurrency core: GenServer, Supervisor, DynamicSupervisor, Application, Task, Task.Supervisor, Registry, Agent, Stream, System, Process. These are the modules that teach the BEAM actor model (processes, message passing, supervision trees, fault tolerance) in real code. Left out: the rest of lib/elixir/lib (see elixir_stdlib_core.txt) and lib/elixir/src (Erlang compiler internals). Files joined with '--- SOURCE: <repo path> ---' separators, code unmodified.
